apihelp-newslettersubscribe-summary: Iska diiwaangeli ama ka bax diiwaangelinta wargeys.
apihelp-newslettersubscribe-param-id: Aqoonsiga wargeyska ee diiwaangelintiisa la beddelayo.
apihelp-newslettersubscribe-param-do: Falka la samaynayo. Waa inuu noqdaa midkood <kbd>subscribe</kbd> ama <kbd>unsubscribe</kbd>.
apihelp-newslettersubscribe-example-2: Ka bax diiwaangelinta wargeyska leh aqoonsiga 2.
apihelp-newslettermanage-param-do: Falka la samaynayo. Waa inuu noqdaa midkood <kbd>addpublisher</kbd> ama <kbd>removepublisher</kbd>.
apihelp-newslettermanage-param-publisher: Aqoonsiga isticmaalaha ee daabacaha la maamulayo.
apihelp-newslettermanage-example-1: Ku dar daabace leh aqoonsiga isticmaalaha 3 wargeyska leh aqoonsiga 1.
apihelp-newslettermanage-example-2: Ka saar daabacaha leh aqoonsiga isticmaalaha 5 wargeyska leh aqoonsiga 2.
newsletter-api-error-nopermissions: Ma haysatid oggolaansho aad ku maamusho wargeyskan.
newsletter-api-error-nocreate: Ma haysatid oggolaansho aad ku abuurto wargeysyo.
newsletter-api-error-subscribe-notlogged: Waa inaad soo gashaa si aad iska diiwaangeliso wargeysyada.
